dct_alternative_sm: Waterstaatskaart van Nederland : op de schaal van 1:50.000
dct_description_sm: The first edition of the Waterstaatskaart, a 1:50,000 thematic map series of the hydrology and water management of the whole of the Netherlands: waterways, polders and their boundaries, dikes, sluices, pumping stations, and summer and winter water levels, printed over a grey impression of the Topographic Map of the Netherlands. Its sheets were surveyed and drawn between 1865 and 1894.

A paged manifest whose georeferencing is spread across its canvases: twelve canvases of front matter (an index sheet, title page, and explanatory text), then 184 map sheets, each linking its own Allmaps annotation page by id with "purpose": "georeferencing" rather than embedding it. No georeference annotation is named in dct_references_s, so both tabs depend on the viewer reading every canvas. The map tab draws the sheets as their pages arrive.
The manifest is TU Delft's copy for the Watertijdreis project; the scans are served by Utrecht University Library.
